title: IKEA Tradfri Outlet Unexpected Overnight Load
app: Aqara, IKEA Tradfri, LIFX, Nanoleaf, Shelly, Zigbee2MQTT, Ecobee, and smart blind motors via vendor clouds, LAN APIs, MQTT bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tradfri:device device_class=outlet
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| where hour>=0 AND hour<5
| stats avg(power_w) as avg_power_w by outlet
| where avg_power_w>40
| sort - avg_power_w
description: Uses Tradfri outlet power telemetry telemetry to monitor overnight power draw on smart outlets that should be quiet in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for devices silently chewing through power overnight, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Tradfri outlet power telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Outlet table of average overnight load.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers overnight power draw on smart outlets that should be quiet so you can spot devices silently chewing through power overnight before it becomes annoying.
